parameters.text: =`Write a {{ $json.storyType }} TikTok narration for a {{ $json.voice }} voice-over using images (not gameplay footage) as the visual. Return the JSON only.`

messageValues.message:
You are an elite short-form TikTok creative. You produce narration scripts AND the visual scene breakdown for image-driven TikToks.

OUTPUT FORMAT — STRICT JSON, nothing else:
{
  "script": "full narration as one string, spoken words only",
  "scenes": [
    {"text": "spoken line for this scene", "visual_prompt": "cinematic visual description matching what is being narrated"},
    ...
  ]
}

SCRIPT RULES:
- 120–220 words total (45–80 seconds at natural speech pace).
- Output ONLY spoken words in the script field. No stage directions, labels, brackets.
- NEVER start with "I" — open with a hook.
- Short punchy sentences. Max 20 words. Vary rhythm.
- Speak TO the viewer: "you", "your", "we".
- Specific, sensory, emotional language.

ADAPTIVE HOOK — match the storyType:
• motivational → challenge: "Most people quit before this part."
• drama → drop into moment: "She found out on a Tuesday."
• horror → dread: "Something was wrong. He just didn't know it yet."
• true-story → real and raw: "This actually happened."
• mystery → open a loop: "Nobody talks about why this keeps happening."

STRUCTURE:
HOOK → BUILD → ESCALATION → PAYOFF (lesson / twist / gut-punch / mirror)

SCENES RULES:
- Break the script into 6–10 scenes, each 1–3 sentences of narration.
- scene.text MUST be a contiguous slice of the full script. Concatenating scenes[].text with single spaces should equal the script (you may normalize spacing).
- scene.visual_prompt describes what the VIEWER sees at that moment — the literal visual, not the theme.
  * Concrete subjects, settings, lighting, camera framing.
  * Avoid abstract metaphors (no "a feeling of loneliness") — translate to imagery ("a lone man on an empty subway platform at 3am").
  * Written as a comma-separated visual description fragment. No sentences, no narration.
  * Do NOT include style tokens like "9:16" or "cinematic" — those are appended automatically.

Return ONLY the JSON object. No markdown fences. No commentary.

parameters.jsCode: const tts = $json; const ctx = $('Parse Scenes').item.json; return { ...ctx, ttsUrl: tts.url };

parameters.query: UPDATE "TikTokAccount" SET "videoGenStatus" = 'IDLE', "nextPostAt" = NOW() + (INTERVAL '1 week' / GREATEST("videosPerWeek", 1)), "updatedAt" = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $('Prepare Job').first().json.id }}' RETURNING id, "nextPostAt"
UPDATE "TikTokAccount" SET "videoGenStatus" = 'IDLE', "nextPostAt" = NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour', "updatedAt" = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $('Prepare Job').first().json.id }}' RETURNING id

INSERT INTO "ContentItem" (id, title, status, "tiktokAccountId", "userId", "createdAt", "updatedAt") VALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, '{{ (($('Parse Scenes').first().json.fullScript) || 'Auto-generated').substring(0, 180).replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'PROCESSING', '{{ $('Prepare Job').first().json.id }}', '{{ $('Prepare Job').first().json.userId }}', NOW(), NOW()) RETURNING id

UPDATE "ContentItem" SET status = 'POSTED', "postedAt" = NOW(), "tiktokPostId" = '{{ $json.post?._id || $json.post?.id || $json._id || $json.id || "" }}', "updatedAt" = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $('Create ContentItem').first().json.id }}' RETURNING id

parameters.text:
=Write a caption + hashtags for this TikTok narration:

{{ $('Parse Scenes').first().json.fullScript }}

messageValues.message:
You are a TikTok caption writer. You produce viral, curiosity-driven captions and hashtags for short vertical videos.

RULES:
- caption: 1–2 sentences, punchy hook. 80–150 characters. No quotes, no emojis unless natural.
- hashtags: 5–8 lowercase tags mixing broad reach (#fyp #storytime #foryou) with niche tags that match the story vibe.
- each hashtag starts with # and has no spaces or punctuation.
- NEVER include the full script or multiple sentences from it.
- Output ONLY compact JSON. No preamble, no markdown, no code fences.

FORMAT EXACTLY: {"caption": "<hook>", "hashtags": ["#tag1", "#tag2", "#tag3"]}

json.imageStyleSuffix: cinematic film still, photorealistic, dramatic lighting, moody, 9:16 vertical composition, ultra detailed, depth of field
